runners_data.name: Sovereign Glory
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid debut third, benefits from tactical positioning but faces stronger opposition here

runners_data.name: Super Tuscan
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the likely pace but poor recent form and low TopSpeed rating limit winning chances

runners_data.name: Seed Ya Later
runners_data.note: Won last time in similar conditions with prominent tactics, perfectly positioned to exploit sustainable early pace

runners_data.name: Jolly Good Fellows
runners_data.note: Lone front-runner with proven 5f record, quick return after 8 days could be key tactical advantage

runners_data.name: Passerine
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying lightest weight but lacks a win from two similar course and distance efforts

runners_data.name: Devon Angel
runners_data.note: Prominent style but significantly outclassed on ratings, 25-day break adds to concerns in stronger company

races.paceDynamic: Jolly Good Fellows will set the tempo from the front with no other confirmed early leaders, creating a sustainable pace without early pressure. The prominent brigade of Seed Ya Later, Sovereign Glory, Super Tuscan, Passerine and Devon Angel will track behind in a compact group. With only one true pace-setter over 5f at Bath, the race will develop into a sprint finish from the 2f pole as the field converges. This pace setup strongly favours prominent racers who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the front-runner's workload.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Jolly Good Fellows sets an even tempo without early challenge
scenarios.body: The field stays bunched allowing prominent runners to conserve energy before unleashing their finishing kick in the final furlong. This scenario perfectly suits horses with tactical speed who can position close and finish strongly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Jolly Good Fellows gets soft fractions and kicks clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter exploits the lack of early pressure to build an unassailable lead that the prominent runners cannot reel in. His proven 5f record at this trip becomes decisive in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Our Fella Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling and turns into a pure sprint finish
scenarios.body: The highest-rated runner with unknown style gets the perfect setup for a devastating late charge from off the pace. His class advantage tells when the race becomes a raw speed test over the final 2f.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Jolly Good Fellows goes too fast early or multiple horses challenge for the lead
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainably quick creating a messy finish where form gets turned upside down. Lower-rated horses benefit from the chaos as the principals weaken in the closing stages.

watchPoints.text: Our Fella's market position will reveal connections' confidence given his unknown running style and class advantage
Jolly Good Fellows' early fractions are crucial - too fast and he's vulnerable, too slow and he's dangerous
Super Tuscan showed better form on good ground last year but recent efforts suggest he may have regressed
Seed Ya Later's quick return to 5f after winning at the distance could be significant tactical move by Channon
The prominent runners' positioning through the first 2f will determine whether this becomes a true staying test

runners_data.spotlight: Three years since the last of his three wins; kicks off his 2026 campaign off a career-low mark and with his stable going well; cheekpieces the headgear of choice.

runners_data.name: Some Nightmare
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up performer carrying light weight but trainer winless from five recent runners, needs strong pace.

runners_data.name: Dapperling
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but returning from 94-day break with trainer struggling badly at 0 from 16 in past fortnight.

runners_data.name: Candy Warhol
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with tactical blinkers fitted, racing off bottom weight for this grade and well-placed tactically.

runners_data.name: Hidden Verse
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with recent win on record, well-drawn to get clear run but needs pace to collapse up front.

runners_data.name: Under Curfew
runners_data.note: Ten-year-old front runner with visor fitted, carrying bottom weight but apprentice jockey taking valuable 7lb allowance.

races.paceDynamic: Candy Warhol and Under Curfew are the only genuine front runners in this eight-runner field, setting up a likely honest pace from the start. With six hold-up horses behind them, the early leaders will face limited pressure and can dictate terms through steady fractions. The tactical nature of this small field means the pace-setters can control the tempo, making it harder for the hold-up brigade to find the strong gallop they need. This race shape clearly favours horses with early pace or those capable of racing prominently, as the lack of speed pressure will make it difficult for pure hold-up performers to close effectively.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If Candy Warhol and Under Curfew establish early control without fierce pressure.
scenarios.body: The pace-setters can dictate comfortable fractions and prove hard to peg back in the final furlong. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground as the tempo never becomes truly strong enough for their closing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Duel Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Candy Warhol and Under Curfew engage in a sustained speed battle.
scenarios.body: The two front runners compromise each other through honest early fractions, setting up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses. Late closers can time their runs to perfection as the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If one front runner takes a clear lead while the other settles behind.
scenarios.body: A more tactical affair develops with steadier fractions throughout, allowing both prominent racers and hold-up horses realistic winning chances. The race becomes more about individual ability than running style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Prominent Tactics
scenarios.trigger: If one of the supposed hold-up horses adopts more forward tactics than expected.
scenarios.body: The pace dynamic shifts as an unexpected horse joins the leaders, creating a stronger gallop that suits natural hold-up performers. Late runners benefit from the increased tempo and can deliver their customary finishing kicks.

watchPoints.text: Candy Warhol and Under Curfew must be monitored for early pace intensity as their duel could determine the entire race outcome.
Watch for any hold-up horses breaking from their usual pattern to race more prominently than their style suggests.
The Feminine Urge and Hidden Verse need tracking for their positioning turning for home as the key hold-up contenders.
Danger Alert resuming with new headgear off long break could outrun expectations if pace develops favorably.
Monitor the overall tempo through the middle stages as this will determine whether front runners or closers hold the advantage.

races.paceDynamic: Queen Sana will make the running from the start with no other committed pace angles in this small field. In The City may track her early from a prominent position, but the lack of pace pressure means Queen Sana can dictate comfortable fractions throughout. The sustained gallop will suit horses who can stay on strongly, while the lack of early burn-up removes the typical advantage for front runners at this trip. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can unleash a telling finish over the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Comfortable Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Queen Sana sets uncontested fractions and the field comes home in a bunch
scenarios.body: Noble Vow and any other hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks. The sustained gallop plays directly into their hands as front runners tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Queen Sana's early lead translates into an unassailable advantage despite the pace setup
scenarios.body: She gets such soft fractions that she has enough left to resist late challengers. The 5½f trip just favours her stamina edge over pure speed horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If In The City can stalk Queen Sana perfectly and time her challenge
scenarios.body: Having raced regularly in similar conditions, she uses her course experience and tactical speed to bridge between the leader and closers. Her solid recent form gives her the edge in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Chaos Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If the lack of experience among these runners leads to an unexpectedly messy pace
scenarios.body: Positioning becomes crucial and the more experienced runners struggle with the stop-start nature. This opens the door for an unexpectedly strong showing from the outsiders.

watchPoints.text: Queen Sana if she gets loose on the lead early - could build an unassailable advantage
Far From Fern's debut positioning - unknown style could disrupt the expected pace flow
Noble Vow's finishing kick - will tell us if the pace setup is as soft as expected
In The City's fitness after 293-day break despite recent racecourse form
Princess Of Limnos staying on - any improvement would signal the pace was genuinely strong

races.name: Pockets At Bath Handicap

runners_data.name: Raintown
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse faces a pace scenario that may not suit, but David Probert's presence and proven stamina at this trip offer hope

runners_data.name: Hibernate
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with recent winning form who should get his own way early against this field composition

runners_data.name: Electric Bass
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer in excellent recent form with a significant weight advantage that could prove decisive

runners_data.name: Bobby Dassler
runners_data.note: Veteran getting headgear and a claiming allowance, recent course winner but trainer struggling for winners

races.paceDynamic: Hibernate leads this small field with no serious pace pressure from the other prominent runners Electric Bass and Bobby Dassler, who are more likely to settle behind early. With only four runners and Hibernate's natural front-running style against three horses happy to sit off the pace, this sets up a controlled tempo throughout. Raintown as the sole hold-up horse will rely on the pace quickening late, but the gentle early gallop may not provide enough late kick. This race shape strongly favours the front-runner and prominent racers who can control their own destiny.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hibernate Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Hibernate gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The four-year-old sets sustainable splits without pressure and has enough left to repel late challenges. His recent Goodwood win shows he thrives when allowed to dominate from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Electric Bass Times Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Electric Bass tracks Hibernate closely and produces a well-timed challenge
scenarios.body: The consistent stayer uses his strong recent form to wear down Hibernate in the final furlong. His 7lb weight advantage and solid stamina profile prove decisive in this longer test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Raintown Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong enough to set up his hold-up style
scenarios.body: The David Probert-ridden horse gets the perfect setup with a solid gallop to aim at. His best form comes with a strong pace to chase down.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Bobby Dassler Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the veteran finds his best form with the claiming allowance helping
scenarios.body: The seven-year-old benefits from Christian Howarth's 3lb claim and recent course winner form. His headgear and light weight combination clicks into gear.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Hibernate gets pressured early by Electric Bass or Bobby Dassler, as he needs to control the tempo to be effective
Monitor how quickly Raintown can get into contention from the back, as a slow early pace will severely limit his chances
Observe Electric Bass's positioning in the first half-mile, as tracking too close to Hibernate may compromise his finishing kick
Check Bobby Dassler's jumping from the stalls, as his recent form suggests he needs to be handy early to be competitive

races.paceDynamic: Prodigal Son will dictate terms from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this small field. The confirmed lead runner will face little early pressure, allowing him to control the gallop and potentially stretch the field with sustainable fractions. Criminal, Party Island, Premier and Galaxy Wonder will all need to overcome their hold-up styles against a likely tactical tempo. This race shape strongly favours the pace-setter Prodigal Son, as he can dictate without pressure and kick when ready.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prodigal Son Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Prodigal Son gets an uncontested lead and moderate fractions
scenarios.body: Rossa Ryan can dictate the tempo perfectly and time his effort to perfection when the hold-up brigade comes hunting. The lack of pace pressure plays directly into his hands with four horses needing to make up ground late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses goes forward early to pressure Prodigal Son
scenarios.body: This creates a stronger gallop that could set up the race for the genuine closers with more tactical speed. Galaxy Wonder and Premier have shown better finishing kicks when the pace is honest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl
scenarios.trigger: If Prodigal Son goes too slowly and bunches the field up
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and acceleration matter most, potentially suiting Galaxy Wonder's recent form. However, this still gives Prodigal Son first run on his rivals from the ideal position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Cracks
scenarios.trigger: If Prodigal Son fails to see out the trip under pressure
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with a pace collapse, but they'll need serious acceleration to capitalize. Premier's longer absence becomes less of a concern in a truly-run race.

watchPoints.text: Prodigal Son setting uncontested fractions - if he gets an easy lead this becomes very difficult for the closers
Premier shaking off the 252-day layoff rust - any signs of ring-rustiness will end his chances quickly
Galaxy Wonder getting competitive racing room in the straight given his closing style needs clear passage
Criminal and Party Island positioning early - either going forward could change the entire complexion
Prodigal Son's stamina reserves in the final furlong after controlling the pace throughout

races.paceDynamic: Kondratiev Wave looks the only confirmed front runner in this 10-runner field, giving him a clear tactical advantage to dictate terms from the front without early pressure. With nine hold-up horses behind him, this sets up as a steady gallop building to a sprint finish, where positioning and timing will be crucial. The lack of early pace means those who can get prominent positions early (like My Ambition and Havana Club) may find themselves closer than usual. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will develop in the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Kondratiev Wave gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: With no pace pressure, he can dictate fractions and use his stamina advantage over this trip. The hold-up horses will face traffic issues and struggle to make up ground in time.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too slow and the field bunches up dramatically
scenarios.body: A strong finisher with the best turn of foot can sweep past the tiring leaders in the final furlong. This suits horses with proven finishing kicks despite their hold-up style.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Success
scenarios.trigger: If My Ambition or Havana Club track Kondratiev Wave and time their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: These horses can sit second or third, avoid traffic, and strike when Kondratiev Wave begins to weaken. Their recent form suggests they're capable of seizing this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic-Free Hold-Up Winner
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses gets an unusually clear passage and finds exceptional late pace
scenarios.body: Despite the tactical disadvantage, a horse hitting peak form could overcome the unfavourable race shape. This requires both luck in running and superior class.

watchPoints.text: Kondratiev Wave's early fractions - if he goes too slow early he becomes vulnerable to late closers with superior finishing speed
Traffic problems developing in the back straight as nine hold-up horses jostle for position behind the leader
My Ambition and Havana Club's positioning - whether they can track the leader closely enough to avoid the main pack
Pace injection points - if any hold-up horse goes early to avoid traffic it could set up others with better finishing kicks
Racing Demon's fitness after 208-day absence, particularly in the final two furlongs where stamina will tell
